note: An agent proposes a Filters panel to Tempera's program: it adds a view and changes the dock's definition. Apart from index.scenarios.json, since the composition proof of a feature installed into the dock plays those, and a definition that builds the tree a feature is installed in can't change then (the program builds what the document writes).

scenarios.name: tempera-agent-adds-a-filter-panel
scenarios.note: An agent proposes a Filters panel; it waits for review, and once accepted its buttons open the filter dialog

steps.note: onLoad draws the sample at the first frame

propose.author: agent
propose.message: Add a Filters panel: one button per filter, above the Layers panel

add./program/panels.lisp/filter-panel:
(defview filter-panel "A Filters panel: one button per filter, each opening its dialog." []
  `(column#filter-panel :role region :label "Filters" :width "100%" :height 92 :color @panel :gap 6
     (label#filter-panel-title :text "Filters"
       :textColor @muted
       :width 120
       :height 22
       :align {:horizontal start :vertical center}
       :anchors {:left 10})
     (row#filter-panel-buttons :width "100%" :height 60 :gap 6 :wrap true
       (node#filter-panel-start :color transparent :width 4 :height 26)
       ~(repeat [f state.filters :key f.id]
         `(label :id ~(str "filter-panel-" f.id)
            :role button
            :text ~(t (str "filter." f.id))
            :textColor @text
            :padding 6
            :height 26
            :fitText true
            :radius 4
            :color @input
            :borderWidth 1
            :borderColor @border
            :cursor hand
            :tooltip ~(str (t (str "filter." f.id)) "...")
            :hover {:color @hover}
            :onClick ~(handler showFilter {:kind f.id}))))))

set./program/panels.lisp/dock:
(defview dock "The dock, in the standard screen mode: the groups, and the strip of panels that pop out." []
  `(row#dock :when ~(= state.screenMode "standard") :width 304 :height "100%" :gap 6
     (column#panels :point panels.dock
       :role complementary
       :label ~(t "panels.label")
       :width 262
       :height "100%"
       :color transparent
       :gap 6
       ~(colour-group)
       ~(properties-group)
       ~(layers-group)
       ~(filter-panel)
       (node#filter-panel-split :width "100%" :height 1 :color @border))
     (column#panel-icons :role toolbar
       :label ~(t "panels.collapsed")
       :width 36
       :height "100%"
       :color @panel
       :radius @kit.cardRadius
       :alignItems center
       :gap 2
       (node :height 6 :width 1 :style clear)
       (node :use tPopout :with {:name history :icon history :title ~(t "panel.history")}
         ~(history-panel))
       (node :use tPopout :with {:name navigator :icon compass :title ~(t "panel.navigator") :height 250}
         ~(navigator-panel)))))

steps.note: the panels are built by the program: the agent adds a view and changes the dock's definition to show it
